sources.title: Ridgewood — own Lhasapoo crossing program
sources.evidence: New complete substantive kennel page read: explicitly Lhasa Apso/Toy Poodle crossing program with own placed litter records. Broader Poodle parentage used, not universal Toy size/generation. Health, allergy, therapy, family-suitability and inherited-character marketing excluded.

sources.evidence: New substantive page read: named Awit keeper reports both parents already Lhasa-Poo, while definition is Lhasa Apso/Poodle. Confirms name not restricted to first-generation equal pedigree fractions. All individual character, behavior and medical claims excluded.
